description: This file defines the MemorySessionStorage class implementing session storage interface for in-memory session handling within the OrangeHRM project. It manages session bags and metadata, providing methods for starting, regenerating, and clearing sessions.

classes.name: MemorySessionStorage
classes.description: Implements a session storage mechanism that keeps session data in memory, managing session bags and metadata.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the session. In this implementation, always returns true.

methods.name: isStarted
methods.description: Checks if the session has started. Always returns true in this implementation.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the session ID, returns an empty string in this implementation.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the session ID. No operation in this implementation.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the session name, defaults to 'SESSID'.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the session name. No operation implemented.

methods.name: regenerate
methods.description: Regenerates the session, optionally destroying old session data and stamping new metadata.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the session. No operation in this implementation.

methods.name: getBag
methods.description: Retrieves a session bag by name, throws exception if not found.
